# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Iteration 2. Parent = cand_0001 (ACCEPT, val 0.560). Scoring is HARD restriction:
the agent's FINAL code is text-substituted `1_<id>_input`→`2_/3_` and RE-RUN on two more
hidden input files (same layout, different data/row-counts); a task counts only if ALL 3
instances match answer_position. Signature `[1,0,0]`/`[1,0,1]` = passes preview, fails the
hidden re-run = an overfit/generalization gap.

cand_0001 already shipped the three highest-leverage levers: the "RE-RUN ON HIDDEN DATA"
generalization block, the "MATCH TYPE/FORMAT" block, and the verify-before-finish step.
This iteration goes for BREADTH across the residual clusters cand_0001 explicitly deferred
(its "cluster 4 bespoke misreads") — decomposing them into prose-fixable sub-patterns — and
repairs one regression cand_0001 introduced (399-14).

## Ranked issue list (clusters in THIS iteration's ./trajectories/, biggest leverage first)
| rank | cluster | tasks (evidence) | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Input-extent bounded by answer-range / preview | 250-20, 30930, 32975 | Agent loops input over the answer range's last row (or the preview's row count); longer hidden file drops rows | KNOWLEDGE | Add "answer_position bounds WHERE not WHAT-you-read" bullet (prompt.md) |
| 2 | Composite keys / contiguous-run grouping / cross-column coupling | 58890, 32975, 55912 | Lookup key omits a column uniform in the sample; groups keyed by value (leaks across blocks) instead of contiguous runs; output position tied to an "unrelated" column | KNOWLEDGE | Add composite-key/contiguous-run/no-coupling bullet (prompt.md) |
| 3 | Paraphrasing a quoted formula/condition | 6698, 50755, 48983 | Positional refs read as sorted/ranked; exact COUNTIFS relaxed to "≠0"; Excel blank→0 written as None | KNOWLEDGE | New block "REPRODUCE THE STATED OPERATION EXACTLY" (prompt.md) |
| 4 | Empty-vs-zero / "remain unchanged" | **399-14 (cand_0001 REGRESSION)**, 48983, 398-14 | Writes 0/"-"/None into cells the instruction leaves blank ("remain unchanged"), or leaves blank where an aggregate would yield 0 | KNOWLEDGE + STRUCTURE | New "BLANK vs ZERO" block (prompt.md) + refine verify item (a) (task_template.md) |
| 5 | Ignoring embedded/stated examples | 2768, 413-15, 32023, 39946 | File has an "Expected"/example column or the instruction states an example mapping; agent never validates its logic against it | STRUCTURE | New "USE ANY EXAMPLE AS A CHECK" block (prompt.md) + verify item (d) (task_template.md) |
| 6 | Rich-text / conditional-format signals | 14207 | Color/bold marker lives in rich-text runs or a CF rule, not `cell.fill`/`cell.font.color` | KNOWLEDGE | Detection bullet in the "REPRODUCE THE STATED OPERATION" block (prompt.md) |
| — | Volatile "current date" | 32023, 34-5 | "current month"/TODAY() resolves differently at grading vs creation; inherently ambiguous | (not prose-fixable safely) | SKIPPED |
| — | Bespoke/underspecified | 55039, 53449, 53305, 10281, 254-34, 269-44, 347-49, 146-49 | Genuinely ambiguous spec / wrong reading no general rule fixes without leaking gold | — | SKIPPED |
| — | Environment / eval fault | 45944 (known recalc), 53062 (48k-row recalc), 4225 & 55258 (output provably matches the instruction's own example yet [0,0,0]) | Infra, not a prompt defect | ENVIRONMENT | Handed back, not worked around |

## Changes made this iteration (all ADDITIVE — no global rule loosened)
| cluster | edit class | file | what & why it generalizes | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | KNOWLEDGE (missing rule) | prompt.md | Bullet in RE-RUN block: "answer_position limits only WHERE you may write — not the extent of the input; read/aggregate over ALL data rows, never bound the input loop by the answer range's last row or preview count." | BOUNDED — passing tasks already read full data ([1,1,1]); rule only describes that behavior. |
| 2 | KNOWLEDGE (missing rule) | prompt.md | Bullet in RE-RUN block: build keys from EVERY jointly-identifying column; detect group boundaries by CONTIGUOUS runs and reset per boundary (don't key a global dict by value); never tie an output cell's position to a column/sheet the instruction says is unrelated. | BOUNDED — describes correct generalization the passing tasks already do; additive. |
| 3 | KNOWLEDGE (add-the-WHY) | prompt.md | New block "REPRODUCE THE STATED OPERATION EXACTLY": same operators/value set, POSITIONAL refs (not sorted/ranked), Excel blank→0 in lookups/#N/A on miss; honor explicit cell refs; + rich-text/CF detection bullet (cluster 6). | BOUNDED — passing tasks already reproduce exact semantics; additive clarification. |
| 4 | KNOWLEDGE + STRUCTURE | prompt.md + task_template.md | New "BLANK vs ZERO" block: write only where the op produces a value; "remain unchanged" ⇒ leave as-is (don't write 0/"-"); write 0 where an aggregate over blanks yields 0. AND refine verify item (a) so it no longer pressures the agent to fill genuinely-blank cells. | Refinement of cand_0001's own verify text. BOUNDED-in-effect: only changes the wrong (over-fill) behavior; no passing task relied on "fill everything non-empty". Directly reverses the 399-14 regression. |
| 5 | STRUCTURE (self-check) | prompt.md + task_template.md | New "USE ANY EXAMPLE AS A CHECK" block + verify item (d): reproduce the LOGIC that yields any stated/embedded example, confirm output matches it exactly, revise if not. Phrased "reproduce the logic — never copy the example cells" to stay consistent with cand_0001's no-copy-sample rule. | BOUNDED — read-only check ("if it doesn't match, revise"); passing tasks already match their examples, so their trajectory is unchanged. |

## Verify-the-fix (trace → what the edit changes on those exact inputs)
- 250-20: agent looped/aggregated only within the answer range's rows → Cluster-1 bullet forces reading to the last non-empty data row, so hidden files with more rows are covered.
- 32975 / 58890: lookup keyed on a single column that was uniform in the preview, and grouping keyed by a repeated value → Cluster-2 bullet forces composite keys + contiguous-run boundaries (correct once a 2nd segment/duplicate value appears in a hidden file).
- 55912: output position coupled to an unrelated column → Cluster-2 "never tie output position to a column the instruction says is unrelated."
- 50755: took the 2nd/3rd values by SORTING → Cluster-3 "POSITIONAL references … NOT the 2nd/3rd-largest after sorting."
- 6698: relaxed an exact 3-way COUNTIFS into a loose condition → Cluster-3 "same comparison operators and value set."
- 48983: wrote None where INDEX/MATCH into a blank cell = 0 → Cluster-3 blank-handling + Cluster-4 "write 0 where an aggregate/lookup over blanks yields 0."
- 399-14 (REGRESSION): under cand_0001 the agent wrote O=0 for rows meant to "remain unchanged" (its comment literally: "set corresponding OT to 0 as the transferred excess"), driven by verify item (a)'s "none are empty/None." → Cluster-4 block + refined item (a) ("do NOT fill a cell with 0 just to avoid a blank; leave unchanged where the instruction implies no value") reverses exactly that.
- 2768 / 413-15 / 32023 / 39946: files contain an "Expected"/example column or the instruction states an example the agent's output contradicted → Cluster-5 block + verify item (d) makes reproducing those examples a finishing precondition, catching the wrong interpretation.
- 14207: color signal was in rich-text runs; agent read cell.font.color (black) and found nothing → Cluster-6 detection bullet points it at rich-text runs / CF rules.

## Confirmed-SAFE checks I ran
- Placeholders: grepped task_template.md — all six required placeholders + optional {max_turns} intact; my edit touched only step-3 prose (no braces). prompt.md contains no `{`/`}` at all.
- No global decision/permission rule was loosened; every edit ADDS a narrowing/knowledge condition. The one modification to existing text (verify item (a)) makes it MORE accurate, not more permissive, and targets the exact behavior that caused the 399-14 regression.
- Formula tasks: I did NOT touch the "prefer literal values" line and added no "never use formulas" rule — 5 passing tasks (35747, 37962, 45581, 49237, 54675) pass BY writing Excel formulas (recalc'd by LibreOffice); the new blocks don't fight them (a formula cell still reads back populated; "BLANK vs ZERO" only concerns cells the instruction leaves blank).
- No hardcoded task ids/values/answers in any edit; every rule is stated over the input class.

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 4 parallel read-only Explore agents (one per trajectory group) re-classified all 40 failing traces into the clusters above; plus direct `dump.py` reads of 398-14, 399-14, 10281, 269-44, 254-34, 34-5 for the regression/bespoke cases. (One group-B agent's `.output` was a full JSONL transcript that overflowed context — killed it and dumped its remaining tasks directly.) Synthesis + all edits on the main agent.
- Prior iterations: read cand_0001 PROCESS.md + LEDGER + JOURNAL. Built ON cand_0001 (deferred cluster 4, regression 399-14) rather than repeating its levers.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- cand_0001's RE-RUN/generalization block remains the highest-leverage fix — keep it.
- Do NOT ban Excel formulas globally (35747/37962/45581/49237/54675 pass via formulas).
- Do NOT re-tighten verify item (a) back to "every cell holds a value / none are empty" — that phrasing caused the 399-14 over-fill regression; keep the "leave unchanged/blank where implied" wording.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- Volatile "current date" (32023, 34-5): "current month"/TODAY() resolves differently at grade time vs benchmark-creation time; today is 2026-08-02 but the gold is a fixed snapshot — no safe general rule, and a wrong "clarification" risks regression.
- Bespoke/underspecified (55039 near-blank, 53449, 53305, 10281, 254-34, 269-44, 347-49, 146-49): genuine comprehension gaps on ambiguous specs; no general prose fix without leaking gold.
- ENVIRONMENT/eval faults handed back (do NOT optimize against): 45944 (known recalc), 53062 (48k-row recalc), 4225 & 55258 (agent output provably reproduces the instruction's own stated example, yet scored [0,0,0] — looks like a grader/type-coercion fault, not a prompt defect).
